enemy_walker.description: A slow foot soldier that advances straight toward the wagon.
enemy_walker.weakness: Affordable melee troops can hold it while ranged allies attack.

enemy_runner.description: A fast, fragile attacker that rushes gaps in the frontline.
enemy_runner.weakness: Keep a cheap melee blocker ready rather than relying on ranged troops alone.

enemy_bloater.description: A swollen undead attacker that bursts when defeated, damaging nearby allies.
enemy_bloater.weakness: Use ranged attacks or spread your melee bodies before the killing blow.

enemy_brute.description: A durable melee fighter that trades speed for heavy close-range blows.
enemy_brute.weakness: Hold it with a blocker while ranged allies wear it down.

enemy_spitter.description: An ordinary ranged enemy that attacks from behind its frontline.
enemy_spitter.weakness: Break through its escorts or use a spell to reach the backline.

enemy_splitter.description: Splits into two smaller enemies when defeated.
enemy_splitter.weakness: Save courage for a second blocker and use a cleave against the small bodies.

enemy_saboteur.description: A swift raider that prioritizes reaching and damaging the wagon.
enemy_saboteur.weakness: Intercept it early with an affordable melee unit.

enemy_howler.description: Rallies nearby enemies, increasing their damage and movement speed.
enemy_howler.weakness: Defeat the Herald before its escorts gather around it.

enemy_jammer.description: Disrupts the wagon signal, briefly delaying troop deployment.
enemy_jammer.weakness: Keep an existing melee line alive and deploy again when the disruption ends.

enemy_crusher.description: An armored tank that absorbs ordinary physical attacks.
enemy_crusher.weakness: Use armor-breaking attacks or magical damage while keeping a blocker in front.

enemy_shieldwall.description: Intercepts projectiles to protect nearby enemies.
enemy_shieldwall.weakness: Engage the formation with melee troops and attack its exposed support.

enemy_lich.description: Periodically calls undead reinforcements into the fight.
enemy_lich.weakness: Focus the Lich before repeated summons overwhelm your frontline.

enemy_siegetower.description: A slow reinforcement carrier that delivers enemies near the wagon.
enemy_siegetower.weakness: Destroy it before it reaches your defenses.

enemy_mirror.description: Reflects part of direct damage back to its attacker.
enemy_mirror.weakness: Support attackers with healing and avoid committing a fragile ally alone.

enemy_tunneler.description: Burrows behind the rearmost troop to threaten the backline.
enemy_tunneler.weakness: Keep a spare melee troop ready to protect ranged and support allies.

enemy_boneballista.description: Long-range artillery that can strike the wagon.
enemy_boneballista.weakness: Advance melee pressure or use a spell to interrupt the artillery line.

enemy_catacomb_giant.description: A giant whose sweeping melee attacks hit nearby troops; three smaller enemies emerge when it falls.
enemy_catacomb_giant.weakness: Spread the frontline and reserve a cleave or spell for its smaller bodies.

enemy_revenant_captain.description: An undead commander that rallies its escorts.
enemy_revenant_captain.weakness: Defeat the Captain while holding its escorts away from your support.

enemy_plague_engine.description: Heavy artillery that threatens the wagon from behind enemy escorts.
enemy_plague_engine.weakness: Push through the escorts and keep the wagon repaired while closing the distance.

player_hound.description: A swift, inexpensive melee scout that reaches threats quickly.

player_grenadier.description: A ranged alchemist whose thrown mixtures damage clustered enemies.

player_necromancer.description: A support caster that raises temporary servants from fallen enemies.

player_lantern_guard.description: A defensive melee guard that protects nearby allies.

player_stormcaller.description: A magical ranged specialist that strikes clustered enemies.

enemy_boss.description: Rallies nearby enemies and calls escorts while leading the assault.
enemy_boss.weakness: Protect a melee line, support wounded troops, and interrupt marked casts when possible. Bosses recover quickly from control.
